entries.name: section-blocks-s1-golden-catches-a-page-change
entries.claim: A change to what the purchase order, sales order or shipment page renders (here the shipment page's packed-lines heading) is caught by the golden-render parity test.

kills.name: SECTION-BLOCKS-s1: the purchase order, sales order and shipment pages and their command responses render byte-identically to the recorded goldens
kills.expected: a change to these pages or to a command response from them must be deliberate

entries.name: section-blocks-s1-golden-catches-a-link-panel-change
entries.claim: A change to the receipt page's Receiving actions panel, which the application extension still serves, is caught by the same golden render.

kills.name: SECTION-BLOCKS-s1: the purchase order, sales order and shipment pages and their command responses render byte-identically to the recorded goldens
kills.expected: a change to these pages or to a command response from them must be deliberate
